data.title: 克莱尔 · 寝室门前的惯例锁喉
data.description: 单人宿舍房间门前，身穿黑色贴身背心的克莱尔单臂锁住席德的脖颈，凶狠微眯的紫眸近在咫尺，微喘的气息扫在对方耳畔，嘴里虽在训斥，眼角却透着浓浓的眷恋。
data.location: academy student dormitory doorway with warm wooden floor
data.action: playfully putting Cid in a headlock under her arm, fierce yet fond violet eyes up close with an angry blush, leaning near his ear
data.lighting: warm hallway ceiling lamp casting intimate shadows on bare shoulders
data.mood: intense aggressive tsundere sister affection, hilarious possessiveness, intimate proximity
data.promptProse: In a dorm doorway, athletic black-haired ponytail Claire puts someone in a close headlock with a fierce blushing glare.
data.animaCaption: Claire affectionately headlocking Cid at the dorm doorway.
